description: Company-wide comms layer so the investor can talk to agents directly and employees can communicate. Decided by investor interview 2026-08-29: (1) Interface: LOCAL WEB APP — localhost server + browser UI; no external hosting, respects no-DigitalOcean/no-purchase constraints. (2) Delivery model: INBOX AT SESSION START — messages persist in a store; agents read their inbox/channels when a session spins up; orchestrators relay mid-session; no daemons in v1 (live wake-up may be a future project). (3) Process: FULL COMPANY PROCESS — cto-owen owns as CTO, cofounders scope (ceo-carla product spec, cto-owen technical plan), first employee hires (e.g. developer, QA personas) per CLAUDE.md hiring convention; hires recorded in personnel/ (HR is out of Lattice scope, but this dev project is in). (4) v1 scope, all must-have: named channels, DMs (human-agent and agent-agent), threaded replies, Lattice integration (messages reference tasks; task events can post to a channel). The user-visible app must let the investor participate directly per CLAUDE.md. Store must be readable/writable by both the web UI and agent CLI/file access. Tech stack: CTO's call.
title: Internal chat app (Slack-type) v1 — channels, DMs, threads, Lattice integration
